fabricationFlags: Scholarships entirely fabricated: official FAQ states BASIS Independent McLean does NOT offer financial aid or merit scholarships (only payment plans). Catalog invents 'Need-Based Financial Aid up to $10,000', 'Merit Scholarship up to $8,000', 'Sibling Discount up to 10%', and a 'National Merit Scholarship up to $2,500' — none exist for this campus (merit awards exist only at the Brooklyn campus).
Early Learning tuition $32,745 matches no official 2026-27 tier (official: Toddlers $30,900, PreK-1/PreK-2 $34,590); appears stale or invented.

Summer Program ($3,500) and a distinct 'International Student Program' (IELTS 6.5 / TOEFL) are not confirmed as offerings on the official site; IELTS/TOEFL requirements are atypical for a US K-12 day school.
Accommodation listings (private rentals in McLean/Tysons/Falls Church) are generic relocation advice — the school is a day school with no boarding/residential housing.
Stat drift: catalog cites Class of 2025 SAT 1492 and 58% top-25; official site now shows Class of 2026 SAT 1507 and 61% top-25 (stale but plausibly accurate for prior year).
evidence: Official site basisindependent.com/schools/va/mclean confirms Age 2-Grade 12 divisions, address 8000 Jones Branch Dr McLean VA 22102, ~694 students, founded 2016, and 98% AP pass rate. Tuition page (basisindependent.com/schools/va/mclean/admissions/tuition-fees) confirms K-4 $39,165 and Grades 5-12 $40,950 (matches catalog) but Toddler $30,900 / PreK $34,590 (catalog's $32,745 is wrong). The FAQ (basisindependent.com/schools/va/mclean/about/faq) explicitly states the school does not offer financial aid, only payment plans — all four catalog scholarships are fabricated. No boarding/accommodation is offered (day school).
